content.definitionEn: Made more concentrated by taking away some of the water from a liquid.

examples.en: The recipe uses condensed milk to give the filling a rich texture.
examples.vi: Công thức dùng sữa đặc để phần nhân có kết cấu béo ngậy.

content.grammarNotesEn: Often before a noun naming a liquid, as in condensed milk. Condensed is also used for shortened texts in a different context.
content.meaningVi: được làm đặc hơn bằng cách loại bớt nước

additionalBoundaryProposals.rationaleVi: Nguồn nói chất lỏng làm đặc và ví dụ milk; draft rút gọn văn bản không đại diện nghĩa này.

content.definitionEn: Stretchy material that returns towards its earlier shape and is used to hold things or fit clothing closely.

examples.en: Lan replaced the worn elastic in the waistband of her skirt.
examples.vi: Lan thay phần chun đã mòn ở cạp váy.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable when naming the material: a piece of elastic; elastic in a waistband.
content.meaningVi: chất liệu co giãn, thường dùng làm dây chun hoặc phần bo quần áo

additionalBoundaryProposals.rationaleVi: Meaning nguồn mô tả vật liệu nhưng tag adjective; Cambridge noun xác nhận vật liệu. Giữ tag conflict và danh tính noncanonical.

records.after: Uncountable; washing of something names the cleaning activity, as in the washing of the curtains.
records.before: Uncountable action nominal; source act/object distinction may be represented as usage variants.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: Câu source act/object distinction bàn cách biểu diễn taxonomy. Giữ danh từ hành động không đếm được và bổ sung mẫu of the curtains từ ví dụ đã đọc.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Countable: a week, two weeks. In a week can mean within or after a period of seven days, depending on context; every week means each week.
records.before: Countable; calendar conventions vary; each-week use is a construction, not automatically a distinct Sense.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: Câu not automatically a distinct Sense là quyết định phân Sense, không là grammar. Thay bằng countability và cách dùng in/every week; không đổi example.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Comparative of badly: play worse, perform worse. Use worse than to compare how well two people or things do something.
records.before: Comparative of badly in this example; owner may represent adjective/adverb as related usages.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: Câu owner may represent adjective/adverb là việc phê duyệt. Giữ comparative badly và cách so sánh trình bày rõ chức năng adverb trong played worse.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Used as a noun without an article in expressions such as fear worse or expect worse; the situation supplies what the worse outcome might be.
records.before: Nominal worse; source NOUN convention is provisional, no distinct canonical identity assigned.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: Source NOUN convention và canonical identity assigned là provenance. Example fear worse có thể hướng dẫn nominal use mà không tuyên bố taxonomy đã duyệt.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Countable: a vegetarian, several vegetarians. Some vegetarians eat eggs or dairy products, unlike vegans.
records.before: Countable; some vegetarians eat eggs or dairy products, unlike vegans. This record proposes the person noun.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: This record proposes the person noun mô tả bản ghi. Giữ countability và đối chiếu vegetarian/vegan hữu ích, thêm mẫu danh từ.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Before a noun or after a linking verb: a white curtain; the curtain is white. Whiter and whitest are comparative and superlative forms.
records.before: Before a noun or after a linking verb; this proposed sense is colour, not a category of people.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: This proposed sense là lời giới hạn biên tập. Thay bằng vị trí tính từ và dạng so sánh thay vì tuyên bố boundary được duyệt.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Usually uncountable when naming the colour: choose white for the walls; paint something in white.
records.before: Usually uncountable for the colour; this record does not propose a racial or other unrelated noun sense.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: This record does not propose a racial or other unrelated noun sense là quyết định manuscript. Giữ danh từ màu không đếm được và mẫu đúng màu trong example.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Transitive: inflate a tyre or a balloon. Also intransitive: the tyre inflated. Inflated and inflating are the regular forms.
records.before: Transitive inflate a tyre; also intransitive the tyre inflated. This draft concerns filling with gas, not price inflation.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: This draft concerns nói phạm vi draft, không chỉ dẫn người học. Giữ cả cấu trúc transitive/intransitive trong nghĩa bơm khí và thêm biến hình, không tạo nghĩa kinh tế.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Transitive: prescribe a treatment; prescribe something for someone. Prescribe and describe are different verbs.
records.before: Transitive; prescribe something for someone. Prescribe is different from describe; no dose is specified here.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: No dose is specified here nhận xét nội dung example, không là grammar. Giữ cấu trúc prescribe for và phân biệt describe; không thêm liều thuốc hay hướng dẫn điều trị.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged

records.after: Transitive: peel a carrot or peel the skin off a vegetable. Peeled and peeling are the regular forms.
records.before: Transitive: peel a carrot. Peeled and peeling; no peel noun is proposed in this boundary.
records.evidenceScope: Actual latest bilingual content inspection and entire original batch review; AI interpretation only
records.rationaleVi: No peel noun is proposed in this boundary bàn kế hoạch Sense. Giữ động từ bỏ vỏ, object và dạng chia, không quyết định có hay không noun Sense trong canonical.
records.relatedFieldImpact: None; definition, meaning and examples remain unchanged
